source_document.title: 2021 International Residential Code, Chapter 3, first printing
source_document.verification: Primary publisher indexed sections reviewed; direct chapter fetch returned HTTP 403. Text below is assistant paraphrase for planning, NOT original source text and NOT fed to any model. Retrieve authoritative clause text before drafting.
source_document.jurisdiction: Demonstration of the selected code only. No claim that it legally governs the UK drawing or Moroccan projects.

drawing.style: Metric thin-line bungalow floor plan with printed room dimensions
drawing.annotation: Assistant reference, no independent review; functional space points do not prove complete room inventory

conditional_case: Kitchen exceptions in R304.1/R304.2 must remain explicit; unknown room class cannot silently bypass or satisfy them.
approval: Every complete meaning must be reviewed/edited before execution. No scalar fact default or automatic completeness attestation.

requirements.name: Habitable room usable area
requirements.interpretation_paraphrase: Habitable rooms need at least 70 square feet; kitchens are excepted.
requirements.needed_facts: habitable room membership, kitchen exception, usable area; resolve ceiling-related exclusions from R304.3
requirements.evidence_location: Room labels and interior dimension/area notes; reviewer confirms usable-area basis
requirements.blocker: Authoritative source text and quota-available typed drafting required

requirements.name: Habitable room minimum dimension
requirements.interpretation_paraphrase: Each horizontal dimension of a habitable room must reach 7 feet; kitchens are excepted.
requirements.needed_facts: habitable room membership, kitchen exception, clear internal horizontal dimensions
requirements.evidence_location: Room dimensions, not door widths or exterior bounding boxes
requirements.blocker: Authoritative source text and quota-available typed drafting required

requirements.name: Continuous egress route
requirements.interpretation_paraphrase: Every dwelling portion needs continuous unobstructed travel to the required egress door, avoiding garages; discharge must reach a public way, directly or through a qualifying yard/court.
requirements.needed_facts: complete dwelling/level inventory, confirmed traversal, room classes, required exit and discharge endpoint
requirements.evidence_location: Door relationships and site discharge evidence; unknown-class route remains unresolved
requirements.blocker: Authoritative source text and quota-available typed drafting required

requirements.name: At least one egress door
requirements.interpretation_paraphrase: Provide at least one required egress door per dwelling.
requirements.needed_facts: dwelling boundary, definite egress-door membership, count
requirements.evidence_location: Door designation plus approved egress plan; do not count all detected openings as exits
requirements.blocker: Authoritative source text and quota-available typed drafting required

requirements.name: Egress door operation
requirements.interpretation_paraphrase: The required egress door must be side-hinged.
requirements.evidence_location: Door symbol/type schedule or cited reviewer evidence
requirements.blocker: Authoritative source text and quota-available typed drafting required

requirements.name: Egress door net clear width
requirements.interpretation_paraphrase: Required-door clear opening must be at least 32 inches, measured between leaf face and stop at 90 degrees.
requirements.needed_facts: required egress-door identity, clear opening measurement basis
requirements.evidence_location: Explicit clear-width schedule/detail; nominal leaf dimensions are insufficient
requirements.blocker: Authoritative source text and quota-available typed drafting required

requirements.name: Egress door net clear height
requirements.interpretation_paraphrase: The clear opening height must reach 78 inches, from threshold top to stop bottom.
requirements.needed_facts: required egress-door identity, net clear height measurement basis
requirements.evidence_location: Explicit clear-height schedule/detail; never substitute nominal height
requirements.blocker: Authoritative source text and quota-available typed drafting required

requirements.name: Hallway width
requirements.interpretation_paraphrase: Hallways must be at least 3 feet wide.
requirements.needed_facts: hallway membership and clear width, complete covered scope
requirements.evidence_location: Internal dimensions or verified-scale geometry; unknown inventory prevents universal pass
requirements.blocker: Authoritative source text and quota-available typed drafting required
